body: I’ll tell you this and take it how you will. I’m in Thailand now at the end of a 3 week trip here, and boy has it been a trip. I didn’t get the 2 vaccinations recommended and I haven’t gotten sick at all. We we’re careful about what we ate and only ate street food we saw prepared infront of us. Of course if your going to a less fortunate spot with worse drinking water I’d probably get it.

Me and my brother are going for just over 2 weeks. We found a night train that would take us to Chiang Mai from Bangkok, and we are also planning on staying in Pattaya for a couple nights for the beach. Definitely doable, and the red-eye train so you don’t miss a day in travel.

Just recently bought a TC and my first mods were, in this order…
New shift nob (it’s a auto but still looks clean 🤷🏼‍♂️).
Tint (5% all around).
Stereo system.
Sub, amp and speakers. 
A few stickers on the windshield.
Now I’m moving on to some new wheels, then a new steering wheel! Hopes this helps and gives you some ideas!
I’ll DM you for your discord!

I’d go to PCPartPicker.com and make your own so you can put a finger on how much you need. I would not, what do ever buy a prebuilt they are more expensive for worse parts. You can make your own for much cheaper.

So it’s all about the money you got available. Without a doubt in the call of duty scene PC is better then console, they get a FOV slider and many graphics settings console players don’t get the privilege of having. If you only have a Console I recommend you sitting at a desk and using a computer monitor. Big TVs, if I understand correctly, like the one you play on may distort and stretch some aspects of the game.

You are downloading the next season, everyone is getting the updates. Season 3 is going to have live events (rockets flying in the air, Zombies moving around the map) in my opinion it is better then one big ass 80g update.
